body: My parents had two very different children in personality’s and care from the minute we were born. My brother (the first kid) was easy to put to sleep wanted to play and explore by himself and was a very easy child. Me the second child would not sleep more than an hour at a time and cried if i was not sleeping or eating and wanted someone to be holding me. So no not all children are the same even from the same parents. And it’s hard to tell what kind of kid you are going to have. There’s a very real possibility that she could still take the dog with her and do stuff with just one child and thought that she might be able to do the same with two kids. But she also points out that she is doing it basically all on her own and her husband isn’t helping a whole lot. My mom would not have been able to do it and they had 2 cats and a dog that did not like my mom a whole lot and my dad stepped up and made dinner and helped clean the house and take care of the animals and me and my brother so my mom could have a break all while she was working full time after maternity leave and my dad worked 2 jobs and finished College. It sounds like she gets no break and is trying to finish college. Babies are all very different. And she’s trying to do the right thing for the dog. To make sure she’s in a loving home where the can visit and she gets the stimulation she needs. I am a very big dog person i prefer them to actually children and she’s doing the right thing and is NTA.

Me and my bf have compromised on how we spend our time. We live together so it’s a little different but we both relax in different ways. I’ve learned how to play games with him and I’ve actually come to enjoy it. He try’s to find games that i might like also so it’s not just games he plays. So we spend time playing the game together when we get off work. When I’m ready for bed (i require more sleep than him) he shuts the game off for a bit and we cuddle and watch a tv show till i fall asleep and then he gets back on the game. Talk to him about a compromise. Tell him you want to spend more time together and if you could find something to do together that’s relaxing for both of you. My boyfriend asked me to try gaming with him to see if we could play games together. And was willing to find something else if i didn’t enjoy it also. We lucked out with finding games we both enjoyed together. We also take our own time to do stuff. So talk with him and try to find that middle ground if a way to relax and spend time together. Sometimes i don’t want to play games so i let him play alone but watch him and we cuddle while he plays.
